scope: Independent bounded front portico pier side-color review. Not complete exterior coloration, surveyed geometry, or printability certification.
findings: Personally viewed official-view1 and official-view3 at full size, plus the four-source contact sheet. The visible entrance piers and side returns are consistent with a pale stone family. Unseen faces are not separately evidenced.

Independently derived three pier boxes from original build_model.py and tested their finite local coordinates and outward vertical boundary planes. Each has 14 original vertical side triangles, including 2 previously colored front triangles. Exactly 36 neutral triangles change.
Original 258 colored faces, all vertices and 12,596 triangles, STL, OBJ and build source remain unchanged. 3MF matches NPZ vertices, faces and material indices.
No adjacent coplanar faces have conflicting material indices. All unselected faces, including pier caps, rear piers, glazing and screen grooves, retain their original materials.
Actually viewed all ten completed renderings, including full-size entrance detail. The local pale returns are consistent, rear piers stay neutral, and no caption overlays appear.

Reopened both scenes and verified exact mesh faces/material assignments, vertex coordinates within Blender storage tolerance, camera, lighting, mesh-object list, render settings and palette shaders. Caption/backing remain hidden and stamps disabled.
README discloses nominal same-pier continuity for unseen faces, unknown source dates, incomplete wall/window coloration, preserved geometry and lack of physical print testing.
limits: Nominal #D1C7B3 is not a calibrated measured stone color.
Unseen rear-facing vertical surfaces of the same front piers use explicitly inferred continuity.
Source photograph dates are unverified. No current 2026 or as-built claim.
Existing simplified dimensions, screen geometry and other model limitations remain; no new geometric accuracy or printability certification.
Only the existing main block is reviewed; low pavilion and long bridge remain excluded.
